name: slng-voice-core-client
description: Builds core/src/core/client/sdk.js: Pipecat's official web client SDK, unmodified, as one browser module.

scripts.build: esbuild sdk.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --legal-comments=inline --outfile=../src/core/client/sdk.js --banner:js="/* Generated by core/client (npm run build) from @pipecat-ai/client-js 1.13.1 and @pipecat-ai/small-webrtc-transport 1.10.8, unmodified. Do not edit. */"
